conversation.content: Let's start this deployment record for the billing API service.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/service_name", "value": "billing-api"}]
For the workload, start with the primary container named billing-api.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod", "value": {"containers": [{"name": "billing-api"}]}}]
Give that main container a modest CPU reservation.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/0/cpu_request_millicores", "value": 500}]
Set its memory reservation to one gibibyte.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/0/memory_request_mib", "value": 1024}]
Have it listen on the usual web traffic port.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/0/exposed_port", "value": 8080}]
Add a metrics helper alongside it called metrics-agent.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/-", "value": {"name": "metrics-agent"}}]
Keep that metrics helper lightweight on CPU.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/1/cpu_request_millicores", "value": 100}]
Give the metrics helper a small memory reservation too.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/1/memory_request_mib", "value": 128}]
Expose the metrics helper on its scraping endpoint.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/1/exposed_port", "value": 9090}]
Add a log-shipping sidecar called log-forwarder.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/-", "value": {"name": "log-forwarder"}}]
Reserve a small slice of CPU for the log shipper.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/2/cpu_request_millicores", "value": 150}]
Give the log shipper enough memory to buffer bursts.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/2/memory_request_mib", "value": 256}]
Have the log shipper publish its local intake endpoint on port 24224.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/2/exposed_port", "value": 24224}]
Add an authentication proxy sidecar called auth-proxy as well.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/-", "value": {"name": "auth-proxy"}}]
Allocate a moderate CPU reservation for the auth proxy.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/3/cpu_request_millicores", "value": 250}]
Give the auth proxy half a gibibyte of memory.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/3/memory_request_mib", "value": 512}]
Expose the auth proxy on its local listener.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/containers/3/exposed_port", "value": 4180}]
Now capture that the pod is running four containers altogether.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/container_count", "value": 4}]
Add up the CPU reservations across those containers for the pod summary.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/total_cpu_request_millicores", "value": 1000}]
Do the same total for the memory reservations.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/total_memory_request_mib", "value": 1920}]
List the pod ports together so the deployment summary shows what it exposes.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pod/exposed_port_list", "value": [8080, 9090, 24224, 4180]}]
Place this rollout in production for the payments namespace in the Virginia region.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/deployment", "value": {"environment": "production", "namespace": "payments", "region": "us-east-1"}}]
Attach the release tracking details with version 2026.06.0, change ticket CHG-48291, and Mira Chen as the requester.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/release", "value": {"version": "2026.06.0", "change_ticket": "CHG-48291", "requested_by": "mira.chen"}}]
Use a rolling rollout with three replicas and allow one extra pod during updates.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/deployment/rollout_strategy", "value": {"type": "RollingUpdate", "replicas": 3, "max_surge": 1}}]
Configure the service checks with separate ready and live endpoints, and use a five-second timeout.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/health_checks", "value": {"readiness_path": "/ready", "liveness_path": "/live", "timeout_seconds": 5}}]
Pin the application image to the internal registry under the billing API repository with the same release tag.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/image", "value": {"registry": "registry.internal.example.com", "repository": "payments/billing-api", "tag": "2026.06.0"}}]
Set the service account and the two standard app labels for this workload.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/identity", "value": {"service_account": "billing-api-sa", "app_label": "billing-api", "tier_label": "backend"}}]
Run it on Linux payment nodes with the standard priority and spread pods across zones.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/scheduling", "value": {"node_pool": "payments-linux", "priority_class": "standard", "topology_spread_key": "topology.kubernetes.io/zone"}}]
Expose the workload internally through a private cluster service on HTTP with session affinity disabled.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/networking", "value": {"service_type": "ClusterIP", "protocol": "HTTP", "session_affinity": "None"}}]
Add the standard traffic policy: keep retries to two, use a thirty-second request cap, and enable mTLS.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/traffic_policy", "value": {"retry_attempts": 2, "request_timeout_seconds": 30, "mtls_enabled": true}}]
Send application telemetry to Datadog, keep traces sampled at ten percent, and retain logs for two weeks.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/observability", "value": {"telemetry_backend": "datadog", "trace_sample_rate": 0.1, "log_retention_days": 14}}]
Add autoscaling guardrails with a floor of three pods, a ceiling of eight, and target CPU at sixty percent.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/autoscaling", "value": {"min_replicas": 3, "max_replicas": 8, "target_cpu_utilization_percent": 60}}]
Harden the pod by running without root, keeping the filesystem read-only, and using the default seccomp profile.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/security_context", "value": {"run_as_non_root": true, "read_only_root_filesystem": true, "seccomp_profile": "RuntimeDefault"}}]
For configuration, point it at the billing settings bundle, the payment secrets bundle, and UTC time.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/configuration", "value": {"config_map": "billing-api-config", "secret_ref": "payments-prod-secrets", "timezone": "UTC"}}]
Add the production database connection details: use the billing database host, the main database name, and SSL required.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/database", "value": {"host": "billing-prod.cluster.local", "name": "billing", "ssl_required": true}}]
Set the cache to use the Redis endpoint, database zero, and a ten-minute default expiry.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cache", "value": {"endpoint": "redis-payments.prod.svc", "database_index": 0, "default_ttl_seconds": 600}}]
Add the paging details so incidents route to the payments platform team, with critical severity and PagerDuty as the channel.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/incident_response", "value": {"owner_team": "payments-platform", "severity": "critical", "notification_channel": "pagerduty"}}]
Add the backup plan with nightly snapshots, thirty-day retention, and restore testing enabled.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/backup", "value": {"schedule": "nightly", "retention_days": 30, "restore_test_enabled": true}}]
Record the compliance posture as PCI scope, encrypting traffic in transit, and sending audit events to the finance index.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/compliance", "value": {"pci_scope": true, "encryption_in_transit": true, "audit_log_index": "finance-audit"}}]
Add the maintenance window for Sunday at 02:00 UTC, with a one-hour duration.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/maintenance_window", "value": {"day": "Sunday", "start_time_utc": "02:00", "duration_minutes": 60}}]
Add the alert thresholds for availability at 99.9 percent, error rate at two percent, and p95 latency at 300 milliseconds.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/alerts", "value": {"availability_slo_percent": 99.9, "error_rate_threshold_percent": 2, "p95_latency_threshold_ms": 300}}]
Add release safety gates that pause automatically on failures, wait ten minutes before promotion, and notify Slack.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/release_safety", "value": {"auto_pause_on_failure": true, "promotion_delay_minutes": 10, "notification_sink": "slack"}}]
Add cost tracking with the finance cost center, the production budget code, and chargeback enabled.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cost_tracking", "value": {"cost_center": "FIN-240", "budget_code": "PAY-PROD-2026", "chargeback_enabled": true}}]
Include the operator reference links: the runbook page, the Grafana dashboard, and the escalation policy name.

[{"op": "add", "path": "/operator_references", "value": {"runbook_url": "https://wiki.internal.example.com/runbooks/billing-api", "dashboard_url": "https://grafana.internal.example.com/d/billing-api-prod", "escalation_policy": "payments-primary"}}]
Add lifecycle notes: keep this record active, review it quarterly, and mark the next review for September 1, 2026.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/lifecycle", "value": {"status": "active", "review_cadence": "quarterly", "next_review_date": "2026-09-01"}}]
Finish with the retention rules: keep deployment artifacts for 180 days, archive them to Glacier, clear temporary files after one day, and require approval before purging.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/retention_policy", "value": {"artifact_retention_days": 180, "archive_storage_class": "Glacier", "temp_file_ttl_hours": 24, "purge_requires_approval": true}}]

edit_instruction: Remove the log-forwarder sidecar from the pod.
conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on a pod with several containers, each with a name, a CPU request, a memory request, and an exposed port, where the pod's container_count, total_cpu, total_memory (stated sums over the containers), and exposed_port_list aggregate over the included containers. Around this core, add the realistic, independent details a deployment record would carry that do not depend on the container list, and vary the number of containers from sample to sample.
edit_pattern: Remove one specific sidecar container from the pod.
cascade_pattern: Removing the container deletes it from the container list, lowers container_count, removes its port from exposed_port_list, and re-derives total_cpu and total_memory as the stated sums over the remaining containers. Unrelated deployment metadata stays unchanged.
annotation_notes: remove log-forwarder sidecar; container_count 4->3, total_cpu 1000->850, total_memory 1920->1664, exposed_port_list drops 24224. | REVIEW EDIT (with author): exposed_port_list re-expressed as a per-element remove op (whole-array replace not expanded by leaf-level scorer -> phantom over+miss even for a perfect model).
